theorem QOU.BraidKnot.M1EdgeCalculus.sum_hookLen_eq_diag (μ : YoungDiagram) {C R T T' : ℕ} (hC : μ.colLen 0 ≤ C) (hR : μ.rowLen 0 ≤ R) (hT : μ.rowLen 0 ≤ T) (hT' : μ.colLen 0 ≤ T') :
∑ p ∈ μ.cells, hookLen μ p.1 p.2 = ∑ c ∈ Finset.range T, (diagLen μ c * diagLen μ c + c * diagLen μ c) + ∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T', (diagLen μ.transpose r * diagLen μ.transpose r + r * diagLen μ.transpose r)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.M1EdgeCalculus.sum_cells_lower_eq_sum_diag (μ : YoungDiagram) {M : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) {T : ℕ} (hT : μ.colLen 0 ≤ T) :
∑ p ∈ μ.cells with ¬p.1 ≤ p.2, f p.1 p.2 = ∑ r ∈ Finset.Ico 1 T, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (diagLen μ.transpose r), f (k + r) k

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.M1EdgeCalculus.sum_cells_upper_eq_sum_diag (μ : YoungDiagram) {M : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) {T : ℕ} (hT : μ.rowLen 0 ≤ T) :
∑ p ∈ μ.cells with p.1 ≤ p.2, f p.1 p.2 = ∑ c ∈ Finset.range T, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (diagLen μ c), f k (k + c)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.M1EdgeCalculus.sum_hookLen_eq_sum_coords (μ : YoungDiagram) {C R : ℕ} (hC : μ.colLen 0 ≤ C) (hR : μ.rowLen 0 ≤ R) :
∑ p ∈ μ.cells, hookLen μ p.1 p.2 = ∑ p ∈ μ.cells, (p.1 + p.2 + 1)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.M1EdgeCalculus.two_mul_sum_hookLen (μ : YoungDiagram) {C R : ℕ} (hC : μ.colLen 0 ≤ C) (hR : μ.rowLen 0 ≤ R) :
2 * ∑ p ∈ μ.cells, hookLen μ p.1 p.2 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range C, μ.rowLen i * μ.rowLen i + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range R, μ.colLen j * μ.colLen j

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.M1EdgeCalculus.sum_cells_eq_sum_rows (μ : YoungDiagram) {M : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) {C : ℕ} (hC : μ.colLen 0 ≤ C) :

∑ c ∈ Finset.range T, diagLen μ c + ∑ r ∈ Finset.range T', diagLen μ.transpose r = μ.card + diagLen μ 0

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.M1EdgeCalculus.card_eq_sum_diagLen_add (μ : YoungDiagram) {T T' : ℕ} (hT : μ.rowLen 0 ≤ T) (hT' : μ.colLen 0 ≤ T') :

∑ t ∈ Finset.range (μ.rowLen 0), (↑(diagLen μ t) - ↑(diagLen μ (t + 1))) = ↑(diagLen μ 0)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.M1EdgeCalculus.diagLen_rowLen_zero (μ : YoungDiagram) :

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.M1EdgeCalculus.kappa_uniform_dot (D : ℕ → ℤ) (T : ℕ) (c : ℚ) :
∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, c * ↑(D t - D (t + 1)) = c * ↑(D 0 - D T)

theorem QOU.BraidKnot.M1EdgeCalculus.weighted_density_eq_kappa_dot {ι : Type u_1} (E : Finset ι) (lo hi : ι → ℕ) (w : ι → ℚ) (D : ℕ → ℤ) (T : ℕ) (hsub : ∀ e ∈ E, Finset.Ico (lo e) (hi e) ⊆ Finset.range T) (hpos : ∀ e ∈ E, lo e < hi e) :
∑ e ∈ E, w e * (↑(D (lo e) - D (hi e)) / (↑(hi e) - ↑(lo e))) = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, kappa E lo hi w t * ↑(D t - D (t + 1))
